description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in Cocoa, Cardamom & Papper growing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter concerning wage adjustments and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
